bds.h: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
bds.lede: Actor and comedian Russell Brand was accused of three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one charge of attempted indecent assault.
rows: Actor and comedian Russell Brand was accused of three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one charge of attempted indecent assault.

British comedian and actor Russell Brand was convicted Thursday of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault linked to allegations dating back more than 20 years. He was acquitted of two rape counts and one count of attempted indecent assault.
Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.
Brand, 51, denied the charges and testified that he was obsessed with sex as a young man and once led a promiscuous life but had never forced anyone to do something against their will.
Concerns remain that media industry is still failing to confront troubling behaviour
The British actor and comedian will be sentenced on Monday, Judge Joel Bennathan said, according to the Associated Press. He was taken into custody.
